author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
In the AI era, don't be a 10x engineer, be a 2-3x engineer.

10x means you over learned that one thing.  No matter how fast you work, you are slower than AI.


2-3x in everything instead.  Humans still have an advantage in dealing with context compared to AI.  1M tokens context window is a lot smaller than you think.  It takes the human brain to figure out how to use that 1M (Gemini) or 200k (Claude) tokens wisely.

#ai #agent #human_vs_ai

comments.text: Yes, it’s about mastering system design and understanding architecture at scale. AI is great at implementation of your design patterns.
